_about: Every spoken line in story mode, by id. web/scripts/voices.py renders each one to public/story/voice/<id>.mp3 with the free Kokoro voice of its speaker (see SPEAKERS in content.js and CAST in voices.py). Change a text, re-run the script, and only that line is rendered again. fx: radio (VHF/intercom band-pass), phone (narrow band), robot (the AI agents). All placeholder dialogue, to be checked by Adriaen.

sola.crew2.text: Follow the yellow walkway to the door, please.

pro.pilot1.text: Morning, everyone. That's the platform, dead ahead.

pro.pilot2.text: Wind on the deck is twenty knots, south-west. Nice and steady.

pro.pilot3.text: One turn round the platform, then we're in. Two minutes.

pro.pilot4.text: Welcome on board. Wait for the rotors to stop, then follow the deck crew.

a1.sup1.text: We're two short today, so I'll take the crane for the boat myself. Haven't done that lift in a while.

a1.sup2.text: Where's the lifting procedure again? Give me a minute.

a1.sup3.text: Found it. Revision five, I think. Right, off to the crane.

a1.plan1.text: Hi, it's onshore planning. Bad news, I'm afraid. The chemical order missed the cut-off, so the containers are still at the supply base.

a1.plan2.text: Next boat is in three days.

a1.op1.text: Three days? We'll be short on scale inhibitor by then.

a1.tech1.text: Control, field. Booster pump A just tripped. Loud noise from the bearing end.

a1.op2.text: B has picked up the load. Suction pressure is swinging all over.

a1.op3.text: B's gone on low suction pressure. We've lost all water injection.

a1.tech2.text: Control, field, I've got alarms on every panel down here.

a1.tech3.text: Which one do you want me to look at first?

a2.op1.text: Let me show you what I've been building.

a2.op2.text: This is yesterday's history for the injection pressure loop. It finds the stretches where the loop ran in manual and moved enough to learn from.

a2.op3.text: So we get a model without a new step test on the live plant. No lost barrels.

a2.op4.text: And this is a physics model of a slugging riser. Watch it fill with liquid, then blow through.

a2.op5.text: Now drag in an anti-slug controller, tuned on that model. The slugs flatten out.

a2.op6.text: Before any of it goes near the real system, the start, stop and fallback logic runs in the logic tester.

a2.op7.text: There. A missing interlock. Found on a laptop, not during commissioning.

a2.oim1.text: So could the AI have done this on its own?

a2.op8.text: It wrote a lot of the code. It didn't know what a slug was, or when the logic was wrong.

a3.sup1.text: Morning, everyone. Quick round before the boat comes in.

a3.sup2.text: Three of us lead the agents today. Each one has a mandate: what it may do alone, what needs approval, and what it never touches.

a3.sup3.text: And this is what connects them.

a3.sup4.text: The chemicals are on the boat this time. Now, the lifting procedure for the supply boat, please.

a3.sup5.text: Good catch. From now on it answers, but the operator checks the citation for lifting and restart procedures.

a3.ana1.text: The root cause analysis is back. Pump A's bearings were wearing for weeks, and the changeover logic couldn't absorb the step.

a3.ana2.text: Vibration on pump A is creeping up again, so maintenance is planned for next week. Before it trips.

a3.eng1.text: I've gone through the model and the test runs. The new changeover logic holds when one pump drops out. I'll co-sign.

a3.eng2.text: No. That's a trip transmitter. We don't inhibit a safety function to quiet the alarms.

a3.eng3.text: Send a work order to the instrument tech. They'll swap it on the next window.

a3.oim2.text: This part isn't ours to decide. It's yours.

t.brage1.name: Brage
t.brage1.text: How does the business plan hold up if the new well comes in three months late?
t.brage1.no: Hvordan holder forretningsplanen hvis den nye brønnen kommer tre måneder for sent?

t.brage2.name: Brage
t.brage2.text: Good. Draft both, and flag anything that needs sign-off offshore.
t.brage2.no: Bra. Lag utkast til begge, og merk det som trenger godkjenning offshore.

t.adr1.name: Adriaen
t.adr1.text: The riser started slugging again overnight. Can you retune the anti-slug controller?
t.adr1.no: Stigerøret begynte å slugge igjen i natt. Kan du justere anti-slug-regulatoren?

t.adr2.name: Adriaen
t.adr2.text: Good. Run it through the logic tester before I sign.
t.adr2.no: Bra. Kjør den gjennom logikktesteren før jeg signerer.

t.adr3.name: Adriaen
t.adr3.text: Signed. A year ago, this would have taken me a week.
t.adr3.no: Signert. For ett år siden ville dette tatt meg en uke.

t.gm4.name: Adriaen
t.gm4.text: There's a little left from the night shift, but I can put on a new pot.
t.gm4.no: Det er igjen en liten skvett fra nattskiftet, men jeg kan sette på en ny kanne.

t.ai1.name: Agent
t.ai1.text: Production dips a little in the third quarter. Two projects can move forward to fill the gap. Shall I draft both?
t.ai1.no: Produksjonen faller litt i tredje kvartal. To prosjekter kan flyttes fram og dekke gapet. Skal jeg lage utkast til begge?

t.ai2.name: Agent
t.ai2.text: Drafts ready. Two items need sign-off, and they have gone to the control room.
t.ai2.no: Utkastene er klare. To punkter trenger godkjenning, og de er sendt til kontrollrommet.

t.ai3.name: Agent
t.ai3.text: New model fitted from last night's data. The proposed tuning holds the riser steady in the simulator.
t.ai3.no: Ny modell tilpasset fra nattens data. Den foreslåtte innstillingen holder stigerøret stabilt i simulatoren.

t.ai4.name: Agent
t.ai4.text: All 14 test cases pass. Ready for your signature.
t.ai4.no: Alle 14 testtilfeller består. Klar for din signatur.

y.ceo1.name: Toppsjefen
y.ceo1.text: Adriaen! Welcome to Aker BP. Good to have you with us.
y.ceo1.no: Adriaen! Velkommen til Aker BP. Godt å ha deg med oss.
